top_issues: Color legend banner competes with balance, while small text relies heavily on purple/green color coding.
fixes: Demote color explainer banner and increase font size of sub-balance labels.

top_issues: Technical route detail panel draws focus away from the primary payment confirmation.
fixes: Collapse raw hex addresses and secondary hub routes into an expandable section.

top_issues: Proof hash and frame number dominate over simple transfer status details.
fixes: Surface recipient friendly name prominently above frame and proof hashes.

top_issues: Account capacity warning is small and risks incoming payment failure without clear explanation.
fixes: Make incoming capacity badge more legible next to the QR code.

top_issues: Collateral slider and credit extension block the primary swap action under dense technical copy.
fixes: Separate credit-line extension into a distinct preparatory step before the order entry.

top_issues: Complex multi-leg terminology and credit setup overlay crowd the swap screen.
fixes: Clarify cross-network status stepper and streamline credit approval messaging.

top_issues: Distinction between credit line, collateral, and promised debt is difficult to parse rapidly.
fixes: Add visual grouping between enforceable collateral and unsecured credit balances.

top_issues: Dispute modal lacks sufficient backdrop dimming, causing serious text collision with the underlying screen.
fixes: Increase modal overlay opacity to 85% to ensure full legibility of dispute text.

top_issues: Two-column layout leaves ample dead space while right-side detail panel feels disconnected.
fixes: Consolidate receipt details into an anchored drawer with clear signed-state indicators.

top_issues: Proof hash presentation is difficult to inspect without opening external tools.
fixes: Add clear one-click verification modal showing signed bilateral signatures.

top_issues: Advanced bar scale preview consumes significant vertical space before basic wallet options.
fixes: Move bar-scale calibration into an advanced appearance submenu.

top_issues: Dual 3x1 matrix for From and To states causes choice ambiguity for basic rebalancing.
fixes: Present transfer source and destination as standard dropdown selectors with context cards.

top_issues: Navigation tiles and risk status cards are sparse and visually unweighted.
fixes: Group sovereignty, assets, and lending actions into structured operational sections.

top_issues: Faucet testnet controls blend directly into production-looking asset management views.
fixes: Clearly isolate faucet utilities with dedicated testnet developer styling.

top_issues: Basis points configuration and pool mechanics lack explanatory risk metrics.
fixes: Show APY percentage equivalents alongside basis points and highlight lockup terms.

top_issues: Board governance concepts are presented with heavy text and little actionable UI.
fixes: Introduce visual threshold diagrams for multi-sig and key rotation states.

top_issues: Counterparty card contains overlapping text artifacts on secondary labels.
fixes: Fix CSS overlapping label bug in counterparty dispute card and format evidence download.

top_issues: Table columns compress numerical data and order book depth bars into a tight grid.
fixes: Provide clear column dividers and allow customizable table row density.

top_issues: Palette overlay lacks contextual category headers for navigation destinations.
fixes: Categorize command palette items under distinct section headers.

overall.verdict: The interface demonstrates a consistent, sophisticated dark design language with strong technical primitives. However, specialized protocol terminology and dense multi-layered state models create friction for non-technical users.
priority_fixes: Fix modal backdrop transparency and text overlapping bugs on dispute and sovereignty screens.
Simplify swap and transfer views by decoupling credit extension into a separate preparatory step.
Reinforce high-contrast text labels alongside purple and green balance indicators.
Provide plain-language summaries for enforceable collateral versus hub promises.
Add explicit dual-signature proof inspection and audit trail views in activity detail.
